name: airbox
description: Airbox - Modern open source streaming and download studio for movies, series, anime, and manga

scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm start
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package
scripts.build:desktop:mac: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package:mac
scripts.build:desktop:all: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package:all
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:gui && cd capacitor && npm run sync:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd capacitor/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node --test backend/utils/constants.test.ts && node --test gui/src/utils/common.test.ts && node --test gui/src/utils/searchHistory.test.ts && node --test backend/utils/personMetadata.test.ts
